title: States Hold $70 Billion That Belongs To Americans
hook: About 1 in 7 Americans has forgotten money waiting.
closing: A free search could reconnect you with money already yours.
question: Have you checked your name?

segments.say: California holds $15 billion in forgotten money. Regular people still own every dollar.
States returned $4.49 billion last year. Most of the nationwide pile remains unclaimed.
About 14.3% of Americans have money waiting. A free search can reveal whether you are one of them.
